PERSONAL LOAN AGREEMENT

This Personal Loan Agreement (the "Agreement"), dated as of the 1st day of January, 2023 (the "Effective Date"), is entered into between Aline Vesna Warmer, a resident of 822 Santiago Mills, Apt. 730, hereinafter referred to as the "Borrower," and QuickLoan Inc., a corporation organized and existing under the laws of the State of Delaware, hereinafter referred to as the "Lender."

WHEREAS, the Borrower desires to obtain a loan from the Lender, and the Lender is willing to provide such a loan, subject to the terms and conditions set forth herein;

NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and promises contained herein and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which is hereby acknowledged, the parties hereto agree as follows:

1. LOAN AMOUNT. The Lender shall provide to the Borrower a personal, unsecured loan in the amount of Ten Thousand Dollars ($10,000), or such other amount as the parties may agree in writing (the "Loan Amount").

2. INTEREST RATE. The Loan Amount shall bear interest at the annual rate of 10% per annum, calculated on a 365-day year basis (the "Interest Rate").

3. REPAYMENT TERMS. The Borrower shall repay the Loan Amount, together with all accrued and unpaid interest, in equal monthly installments over a term of 36 months, with the first such installment due on the first day of the month next succeeding the Effective Date (the "Maturity Date"). Each installment shall be in the amount of Three Hundred Thirty-Three Dollars and 33/100 ($333.33), or such other amount as the parties may agree in writing.

4. SECURITY. This Loan is an unsecured loan, and no security or collateral is being provided by the Borrower to secure the repayment of the Loan Amount.
